title: Abram refuses Sodom's spoils but reserves his allies' share
speaker: Abram
note: Oath answering the king's request (ot-genesis-v14-21); stipulates portions for the young men and Eshcol, Aunan and Mamre.

title: Abraham tells Sarah to hurry and bake cakes for the visitors
speaker: Abraham
note: Hospitality order within the household; nearby records cover only 18:1–5.

title: Lot urges the visitors to lodge and wash in his house
speaker: Lot
note: Invitation pressed again in 19:3; Abraham's comparable offer is recorded (ot-genesis-v18-4, Laban's at ot-genesis-v24-31).

title: Lot: bring your household out of Sodom
speaker: the two angels
topic: Creation, personal commissions and Israel’s journeys
note: At dawn the angels renew the order: take your wife and two daughters and depart. Add 19:15.

title: Lot begs the angel to let him flee to the nearby city
speaker: Lot
topic: Historical commissions, journeys and public life
note: Request granted in 19:21; requests to messengers are recorded (ot-judges-v6-18). Omit if treated as prayer to God.

title: Lot: flee to the permitted place of refuge
speaker: the angel
topic: Creation, personal commissions and Israel’s journeys
note: 19:21–22 grants Zoar as the permitted refuge and orders Lot to hurry there.

title: Abram asks Sarai to say she is his sister
speaker: Abraham
topic: Historical commissions, journeys and public life
note: Abraham recounts the standing request: in every place say of me, 'He is my brother.'

title: Abimelech tells Sarah to speak the truth in all things
speaker: Abimelech, king of Gerar
note: Rebuke after restoring her with a thousand didrachms; no record covers 20:16.

title: Abraham asks Abimelech to accept seven ewe lambs as witness
speaker: Abraham
note: Witness that Abraham dug the well, sealing the oath at the Well of Swearing (21:31).

title: The Hittites invite Abraham to bury his dead in their tombs
speaker: the sons of Heth
note: An offer like Ephron's, which the catalogue keeps as Study Context (ot-genesis-v23-11).

title: Abraham asks to buy Ephron’s cave
speaker: Abraham
note: The request begins in 23:8: 'hear me, and speak for me to Ephron'.

title: Ephron offers Abraham the field and cave
speaker: Ephron the son of Zohar
note: Ephron's renewed offer names the price, four hundred didrachms, and repeats 'Bury your dead'.

title: Abraham charges his servant to take Isaac a wife from his kindred
speaker: Abraham
recipient: his servant, the elder of his house
note: The oath's content; ot-genesis-v24-2 stops mid-sentence at 24:2 (alternatively extend it). Recounted 24:37–40.

title: Abraham's servant recounts his master's charge to seek Isaac's wife
speaker: Abraham's servant, recounting Abraham
note: Recount of 24:3–4; the catalogue keeps his other recounts separately (ot-genesis-v24-43, -45). Or link as Additional Scripture.

title: Abraham states when his servant’s oath will end
speaker: Abraham, recounted by his servant
note: The servant repeats the release clause: if they do not give her, you are free from my oath.

title: The servant recounts his prayer for a sign at the well
speaker: Abraham's servant
note: 24:43 ends mid-sentence; 24:44 completes the recounted sign.

title: Abraham's servant asks Rebekah's family for a clear answer
speaker: Abraham's servant
note: 'Tell me... that I may turn to the right hand or to the left'; their reply is ot-genesis-v24-51.

title: Abimelech’s party seeks a covenant with Isaac
speaker: Abimelech and his officers
note: 26:29 states the sworn term they ask for: 'that you shall do us no harm'.

title: Rebekah tells Jacob to bring two young goats
speaker: Rebekah
note: 27:10 completes the order: take the food to your father so that he blesses you.

title: Esau cries out for a blessing of his own
speaker: Esau
note: Esau repeats the plea in 27:38: 'Bless me also, father.'

title: Rebekah tells Jacob to stay with Laban until Esau calms
speaker: Rebekah
topic: Historical commissions, journeys and public life
note: The order opens in 27:43 ('arise and flee... to Laban') and ends in 27:45; 27:44 alone is a fragment.

title: Isaac charges Jacob about where to seek a wife
speaker: Isaac, as reported by the narrator
note: Narrator restates the charge: 'You shall not take a wife from the daughters of Canaan.'

title: Jacob tells the shepherds to water the sheep and pasture them
speaker: Jacob
recipient: the shepherds at the well near Harran
note: They decline until all the flocks are gathered (29:8).

title: Laban tells Jacob to finish Leah's week and serve seven more years
speaker: Laban
note: Laban's terms after the substitution of Leah; Jacob complies (29:28).

title: Leah tells Jacob to come in to her, hired with mandrakes
speaker: Leah
note: Follows the exchange recorded at ot-genesis-v30-14 (30:14–15).

title: Laban again asks Jacob to name his wages
speaker: Laban
note: A second wage negotiation; could instead be linked to ot-genesis-v29-15 as a parallel.

title: Jacob proposes taking marked animals as wages
speaker: Jacob
topic: Historical commissions, journeys and public life
note: The proposal opens in 30:31 ('You shall give me nothing') and sets the theft test in 30:33.

title: Jacob invites Laban's search and sentences whoever has the gods
speaker: Jacob
note: 'Identify what is yours... take it'; the rash death sentence unknowingly falls on Rachel (31:34).

title: Laban forbids Jacob to mistreat his daughters or take other wives
speaker: Laban
note: Context verse, not flagged as candidate; a term of the Mizpah covenant with God as witness.

title: Laban and Jacob bind themselves not to cross the heap for harm
speaker: Laban; Jacob swears to it
note: Boundary term of the covenant proposed at ot-genesis-v31-44; God judges between them and Jacob swears (31:53).

title: Jacob prepares his servant for Esau’s questions
speaker: Jacob
note: In this numbering the prescribed answer is 32:18–19; the record's 32:17 holds only the marching order.

title: Jacob tells his servants to announce that he is following
speaker: Jacob
topic: Historical commissions, journeys and public life
note: The announcement itself ('your servant Jacob comes behind us') is 32:21 in this numbering.

title: Do not eat the sinew on the broad part of the thigh
speaker: the Torah narrative
note: Rambam N183 is not itemized anywhere; only broad Study Context torah-genesis-32-25. Narrated custom; origin follows Torah-requirement practice.

title: Dinah's brothers deceitfully demand that every Shechemite male be circumcised
speaker: Simeon and Levi, Dinah's brothers
note: Their condition for intermarriage, spoken with deceit (34:13); 34:14 is context.

title: Hamor and Shechem urge their townsmen to be circumcised
speaker: Hamor and Shechem
note: Core of the gate speech; neither ot-genesis-v34-21 nor ot-genesis-v34-23 records the circumcision demand.

title: Joseph tells his brothers to hear his dream
speaker: Joseph
note: A call to listen; compare ot-genesis-v49-1 and ot-judges-v9-7.

title: Joseph's brothers ask Jacob to identify the bloodstained tunic
speaker: Joseph's brothers
note: Deceptive request; echoed by Tamar's 'See to whom these belong' (38:25).

title: Judah tells Tamar to remain a widow until Shelah grows up
speaker: Judah
note: Deferral of the levirate duty; Judah privately fears for Shelah. Background to ot-genesis-v38-24.

title: Tamar demands Judah's ring, necklace and staff as a pledge
speaker: Tamar
note: Pledge terms behind ot-genesis-v38-23; Judah's proposition is ot-genesis-v38-16.

title: Tamar asks Judah to identify the owner of the pledge
speaker: Tamar
note: Context verse, not flagged as candidate; her appeal overturns the order at ot-genesis-v38-24.

title: Potiphar sets Joseph over his house and all he owns
speaker: Potiphar
topic: Historical commissions, journeys and public life
note: Narrated appointment (39:6 in batch); compare AUD-01-41-40. Same pattern: chief jailer at 39:22 and 40:4.

title: Potiphar's wife repeatedly demands that Joseph lie with her
speaker: Potiphar's wife
note: Chapter 39 has no records; compare ot-2-samuel-v13-11. Joseph refuses it as sin before God (39:9).

title: Joseph advises Pharaoh to appoint overseers and store grain
speaker: Joseph
topic: Historical commissions, journeys and public life
note: 41:36 completes the advice: keep the food for the land against the seven years of famine.

title: Joseph orders one brother to fetch the youngest
speaker: Joseph
note: The test is announced in 42:15: you shall not leave unless your youngest brother comes.

title: Joseph tells his detained brothers how to stay alive
speaker: Joseph
note: 42:19 states the terms of 'Do this': one brother held, the rest carry grain home.

title: Jacob refuses to let Benjamin go down to Egypt
speaker: Jacob
note: Answers Reuben's offer (ot-genesis-v42-37); recounted at 44:27–29 and reversed at 43:13.

title: Judah tells Jacob they will not return without Benjamin
speaker: Judah
note: Quotes Joseph's warning (compare ot-genesis-v42-20); his second plea is ot-genesis-v43-8.

title: Judah asks Jacob to send Benjamin with him
speaker: Judah
note: 43:9 adds Judah's surety: 'require him from my hand'; 43:10 closes the plea.

title: Joseph's brothers propose death for whoever has the cup
speaker: Joseph's brothers
note: Self-imposed penalty, modified by the steward in ot-genesis-v44-10; compare Jacob's sentence at 31:32.

title: Joseph rules that the cup's holder stays and the rest go home
speaker: Joseph
note: Joseph's verdict restating the steward's terms (ot-genesis-v44-10); it prompts Judah's plea.

title: Judah asks to speak and begs Joseph not to be angry
speaker: Judah
note: Opens Judah's plea (44:18–34); compare ot-genesis-v31-35, 'Do not take it badly, my lord'.

title: Judah recalls Joseph asking to see Benjamin
speaker: Judah, recalling Joseph
note: 44:23 completes the recalled demand: without your youngest brother you shall see my face no more.

title: Joseph sends his brothers to bring Jacob to Egypt
speaker: Joseph
recipient: his brothers, with a message for Jacob
note: The message continues: live in Goshen near me, and I will nourish you (45:10–11).

title: Joseph coaches his brothers to tell Pharaoh they keep livestock
speaker: Joseph
recipient: his brothers and his father's household
topic: Historical commissions, journeys and public life
note: Aimed at settlement in Goshen, since every shepherd is an abomination to the Egyptians; chapter has only torah-genesis-46-1.

title: Pharaoh assigns Goshen and offers work tending his livestock
speaker: Pharaoh
note: 47:6 continues: 'settle your father and your brothers in the best of the land'.

title: Jacob asks Joseph to bury him outside Egypt
speaker: Jacob (Israel)
note: 47:30 completes the request: carry me out of Egypt and bury me in my fathers' tomb.

title: Jacob adopts Ephraim and Manasseh and sets later sons' inheritance
speaker: Jacob (Israel)
note: 48:5 is the main ruling (Ephraim and Manasseh are mine, as Reuben and Simeon); retitle the record accordingly.

summary: Genesis narrative: 33 new records (mostly human commands, plus the unitemized sinew law, Rambam N183), 21 reference extensions and 3 parallels; curses, blessings, promises, genealogies and prayers need nothing.
